result.description:
At Russells Darwin Transport, we are currently looking for skilled and experienced Diesel Motor Mechanics to join our team.

The role will include but is not limited to: 

* Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using diagnostic tools scanners and technical manuals; provide clear repair recommendations and cost estimates. 
* Perform routine servicing and preventative maintenance, including oil and filter changes, fluid checks, brake inspections, and scheduled servicing to manufacturer and company standards. 
* Carry out repairs, rebuilds and component replacements on engines, transmissions, drivetrains, hydraulic and braking systems using hand and power tools. 
* Test completed repairs by road testing or operating equipment to verify fault resolution and performance. 
* Maintain accurate service records, job cards and compliance documentation in the workshop management system. 
* Ensure all repairs and maintenance comply with relevant transport legislation, manufacturer specifications and WHS requirements. 
* Participate in fault finding, root cause analysis and corrective action processes to reduce repeat failures. 
* Assist with workshop housekeeping, tool maintenance and control of parts inventory to support efficient operations. 
* Provide technical guidance to apprentices and other workshop staff as required. 
* Promote a strong safety culture: follow safe work procedures, use personal protective equipment and report hazards or incidents immediately. 

Key Competencies: 

* Trade qualification: Certificate III in Heavy Automotive Mechanical Technology (or equivalent) or recognised trade qualification in diesel mechanics. Relevant qualification (preferred) in addition to relevant mechanical experience. 
* For applicants without a relevant diesel mechanical qualification, additional work experience (at least 3-5 years) would be required. 
* Proven fault finding and diagnostic skills for compression ignition engines, fuel injection systems, hydraulics and vehicle electrical systems. 
* Proficiency with digital diagnostic software, technical manuals and digital record keeping. 
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to provide practical, cost-effective repair solutions. 
* Good communication skills, able to convey technical information clearly to managers, operators and customers. 
* High attention to detail and commitment to maintain accurate records. 
* Physically fit and able to safely handle heavy components and work in varied workshop conditions. 
* Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to support continuous improvement initiatives 
* Previous experience in vehicle fit-out, transport, mining or heavy plant industries is desirable 
* Experience supervising apprentices or trainees is desirable. 
* Relevant licences or tickets (e.g. forklift licence, elevated work platform) and work at heights / confined spaces training is desirable. 
* Current WA driver’s licence is desirable. 

Salary: $34 - $45 per hour 

If this exciting opportunity to join the team at Russel Transport has sparked your interest, please click ‘Apply Now’!

result.description:
Location: Woolner NT, with work across the Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-time
Hours: 38 hours per week
Salary: AUD $69,000 to $89,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience

About Us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer
The business (ABN 53 603 812 004) is a Darwin-based specialist HVAC hygiene company providing cleaning, inspection and maintenance services for commercial and industrial air conditioning systems, ductwork, commercial kitchen exhaust systems, cool rooms and mould-affected environments throughout the Northern Territory. Our clients include commercial, industrial, Defence and government organisations requiring specialist indoor air quality and HVAC hygiene services.  

We are looking for a reliable HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access) to join our team.

About the Role
The HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access) will carry out specialist cleaning, maintenance and inspection work on HVAC systems located in commercial, industrial and high-access environments. The role routinely involves safely accessing rooftop plant, elevated work areas and other difficult-to-reach locations using approved ladders, elevated work platforms and other approved height access equipment. 

The successful applicant will:
- Safely access rooftop plant, elevated mechanical services, ceiling spaces and other difficult-to-reach work areas using ladders, fall-arrest systems, elevated work platforms (EWPs), scissor lifts and other approved height access equipment to perform specialist HVAC cleaning, inspection and maintenance activities.
- Carry out specialised cleaning and hygiene services for commercial and industrial HVAC systems, ductwork and ventilation systems.
- Clean air handling units (AHUs), plant rooms, supply and return air ducts, evaporator coils, condenser units, filters and associated HVAC equipment.
- Perform commercial kitchen exhaust system cleaning, including hoods, ductwork, fans and associated ventilation equipment.
- Clean cool rooms, ventilation equipment and other specialist environments to maintain hygiene and operational standards.
- Assist with mould remediation and microbial cleaning projects in accordance with company procedures.
- Conduct pre-start inspections of elevated work areas, identify potential hazards and implement appropriate safety controls before commencing work. 
- Operate specialist cleaning equipment, including pressure cleaning equipment, HEPA vacuum systems and other industry-specific cleaning tools.
- Take photographs, complete digital job records, inspection reports and service documentation for completed works.
- Maintain company vehicles, tools, equipment and personal protective equipment in a safe and serviceable condition.
- Work professionally with clients, contractors and other team members while maintaining the company's high standards of workmanship and customer service.

Applicants should have:
- Experience in commercial HVAC cleaning, industrial cleaning, building maintenance, duct cleaning, ventilation system cleaning, or a similar hands-on trade or technical environment.
- Demonstrated ability and confidence to safely work at heights in commercial and industrial environments while complying with WHS requirements. 
- Experience using ladders, elevated work platforms (EWP), scissor lifts or other approved height access equipment will be highly regarded.
- Ability to operate pressure cleaning equipment, HEPA vacuum systems and other specialist cleaning equipment.
- Good physical fitness and the ability to perform manual work in commercial and industrial environments.
- Ability to read and follow work instructions, safe work procedures and site-specific requirements.
- Basic computer or mobile device skills to complete digital job records, inspection reports and photographic documentation.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a small team.
- A strong work ethic, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship and customer service.
- Comfortable working on rooftops, elevated mechanical plant and other high-access locations as part of normal day-to-day duties. 

Applicants should have:
- Current Working at Heights certificate, or willingness to obtain prior to commencement
- Current driver licence.
- Current NT White Card or equivalent
- Elevated Work Platform licence or demonstrated experience operating EWP will be highly regarded
- Confined Space or First Aid training, or other relevant safety training preferred.

How to Apply
We are looking for motivated and reliable people who enjoy practical work and take pride in delivering high-quality HVAC hygiene, cleaning and maintenance services.  

To apply, please submit:
- A current resume outlining your relevant work experience and the contact details of two referees.
- A cover letter (maximum 600 words) addressing the following:
- Why you are applying for this position.
- An example of when you demonstrated excellent customer service, initiative or teamwork (using the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action and Result).
- How your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of this role.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a practical, professional team delivering specialist HVAC hygiene, duct cleaning, kitchen exhaust cleaning, mould remediation and commercial cleaning services across the Northern Territory, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Applications close: 1 August 2026

result.title: HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access)

Position: Automotive Technician (Motor Mechanic)
Type: Full-time
Employer: JG Prestige Auto Pty Ltd
Location: Clayton South VIC
Salary: $79,560 per annum
About the Business:
JG Prestige Auto Pty Ltd is an independent specialist workshop in Clayton South dedicated to Mercedes-Benz and other European vehicles. We deliver dealership-standard diagnostics, mechanical repairs, auto electrical work, air conditioning services and logbook servicing using advanced diagnostic equipment and high-grade parts. Our reputation is built on honest diagnosis, transparent upfront pricing, quality workmanship and a 24-month/20,000 km warranty. We value precision, clear communication and genuine customer care in a professional, well-equipped workshop environment that prioritises accuracy over shortcuts.
About the Position:
The Automotive Technician (Motor Mechanic) is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Mercedes-Benz and European vehicles to a high technical standard. This hands-on role is central to delivering reliable, dealership-level service without the dealership price tag, ensuring vehicles leave the workshop performing safely and smoothly while supporting the growth of a specialist independent business.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using advanced diagnostic equipment (including Xentry/ISTA and similar systems) and interpret live data and fault codes accurately.
Perform scheduled logbook servicing and routine maintenance to manufacturer specifications.
Repair and replace components including engines, transmissions, braking systems, steering, suspension, cooling systems, clutches and related mechanical assemblies.
Carry out auto electrical repairs, battery/charging system diagnostics, and air conditioning inspections, leak testing and re-gassing.
Dismantle, inspect, repair or replace worn or defective parts and reassemble components to correct specifications, referring to service manuals and technical data.
Road-test vehicles where required and verify repairs meet performance and safety standards.
Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, complete job cards accurately and communicate findings clearly to the business owner/customers.
Source and fit OEM or equivalent high-grade parts and support transparent quoting processes.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Automotive Technology, Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
Minimum 4 years’ experience as a qualified Automotive Technician / Motor Mechanic.
Strong technical skills in diagnosing and repairing modern European vehicles, including familiarity with electronic control systems and diagnostic software.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving ability, clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently, follow manufacturer procedures, and maintain high standards of workmanship and workshop safety.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Payroll Officer – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for managing payroll processing activities, maintaining accurate employee records, and ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time. You will work closely with the finance, human resources, project, and operational teams to ensure payroll processes comply with company policies, awards, employment conditions, and relevant legislation.

Key Responsibilities
•	Process end-to-end payroll activities for employees, including weekly and fortnightly payroll cycles.
•	Maintain accurate employee payroll records, including salaries, allowances, deductions, leave balances, and employment details.
•	Verify timesheets, overtime, allowances, leave applications, and payroll adjustments.
•	Ensure payroll calculations comply with relevant awards, enterprise agreements, employment contracts, and legislation.
•	Process new employee onboarding, payroll setup, and employee changes.
•	Manage employee queries relating to payroll, leave entitlements, deductions, and payments.
•	Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for management and finance teams.
•	Process superannuation payments, payroll tax, PAYG withholding, and other statutory obligations.
•	Maintain accurate records and assist with payroll audits and compliance reviews.
•	Liaise with HR, project managers, supervisors, and employees regarding payroll-related matters.
•	Assist with improving payroll processes and maintaining payroll system accuracy.
•	Ensure confidentiality and security of employee payroll information.
•	Follow workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Payroll Officer or in a similar payroll/finance administration role.
•	Experience processing payroll in a medium to large organisation is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of payroll processes, employment conditions, and statutory requirements.
•	Experience with payroll software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
•	Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial and employee data.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	Ability to manage confidential information professionally.
•	Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with employees and management teams.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $75,000 – $90,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work within a growing mining and industrial services organisation.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
